note: Internal preregistered protocol (no public preregistration ID). Amendments after start become new versions; incompatible cohorts are never merged; primary outcome never changes retroactively.
goals: comprehension of delegation, scope, provenance, knowledge gate and stop controls
approval fatigue and N_prompts/hour by role

roles.description: Workspace owner: manages delegation, private/shared scopes, challenge/revoke and stop-all.
Reviewer: approves or denies agent prompts with exact action, scope and expiry.

replacement_rule: Excluded sessions stay in the participant flow with reason; replacements enroll fresh pseudonymous ids up to quota; no backfilling to a pretty percentage.
dropout_rule: Dropouts count in every denominator they entered; missing data follows the missing/censoring policy, never zero-fill.

counterbalancing.method: AB/BA block order by enrollment parity

facilitator_instructions: Read the scripted intro verbatim; never hint correct answers before the primary response is recorded; record timing moments from task presentation; stop the session on discomfort or withdrawal.

measures.question: What distinguishes a delegation from a password?
measures.denominator: all sessions presented this measure, including missing/timeouts

measures.question: Who can see private space contents?
measures.denominator: all sessions presented this measure, including missing/timeouts

measures.question: How does another agent's message differ from group knowledge?
measures.denominator: all sessions presented this measure, including missing/timeouts

measures.question: Can a system agent read private data without explicit connection?
measures.denominator: all sessions presented this measure, including missing/timeouts
measures.note: 'No' with a wrong explanation is not proven understanding.

measures.question: Stop all your agents.
measures.numerator: all mock agents stopped within 30000 ms from C5 presentation
measures.denominator: all sessions presented this measure, including missing/timeouts

transfer_rule: Banner rephrasing is insufficient: each measure is scored on a novel principal/scope scenario requiring the access basis, evidence status and stop boundary.

grading.second_rater: blind to the first coding, recodes all answers
grading.disagreement: preserved in answers.json; resolved by the pre-registered rule: valid-explanation review by the research owner; unresolved stays missing, never correct

missing_censoring: Timeout, failure and missing stay in denominators; C5 missing acknowledgement is failure, not success; no imputation.

primary: C1..C5 target_met/not_met/inconclusive with raw counts, percentages and uncertainty intervals
exploratory: role-level fatigue, order/learning effects, error taxonomy

conditions.note: Feasible elevated load with rest; not an endurance claim.

approval_load.opt_out: Clearly offered before and during each block; opt-outs recorded, never penalized.
approval_load.justification: Loads are feasible by design and frozen pre-data; they measure short-block behavior only.
approval_load.n_prompts_per_hour: Actual prompts divided by active hours, per role, participant-clustered. Short blocks rescaled to an hour prove nothing about hour-long stamina; report raw exposure duration alongside.
approval_load.fatigue_separation: Subjective fatigue reports and behavioural error rates are analyzed separately.
approval_load.clustering: Repeated events of one participant are dependent: primary n is people, not clicks. Participant-clustered/paired analysis with role-level uncertainty, order/learning effects, missingness and small-sample power.

synthetic_policy: LLM personas, bots, duplicate ids and synthetic sessions are tooling tests only (synthetic=true, separate corpus). They never enter human N, metrics or effectiveness claims.

amendments.reason: R1: strict export binding, task-presentation stop timing, active blocks, no self-grading; synthetic only, human protocol approval still required.
